description: List ad campaigns with their honest profit surface. `call` preserves the original v1 fail-closed automation behavior for multi-component rows; `recommended_call` is the additive SCALE/CUT/HOLD recommendation the current engine made. It is backed by `envelope_lower`/`envelope_central`/`envelope_upper`. Read `aggregation_basis` before quoting the low end: single_component_quantiles means it is a calibrated 5th percentile; marginal_endpoint_sum_no_joint_coverage means it is the sum of each component period's own low end, which is pessimistic against independence but is NOT a floor or a guarantee, so describe it as a scenario. The quantile-named `profit_p05`/`profit_p50`/`profit_p95` are null unless one component supplied calibrated ones. Also includes spend, retention, and payback.

app_id.description: Optional app id to scope the result to one app.

cursor.description: Pass the next_cursor from the previous response to fetch the following page. Omit for the first page.

from.description: First UTC day of an explicit window, YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive. Use instead of period; sending both is a 400.

limit.description: Rows per page, 1-200. The API defaults to 50, so a workspace with more than that needs paging.

period.description: Reporting window. Omit to use the endpoint's documented default.

to.description: Last UTC day of an explicit window, YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive. Use instead of period; sending both is a 400.

name: list_campaigns
title: List campaigns
